title: Apache Log4j2 远程代码执行漏洞 (Log4Shell)
description: Log4j2 JNDI lookup feature allows remote code execution via crafted log message strings. Affects Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1.

title: RuoYi 若依管理系统 后台部门管理 SQL注入漏洞
description: The /system/dept/edit endpoint in RuoYi management system is vulnerable to SQL injection via the 'orderByColumn' parameter due to improper sanitization of user input before construction of dynamic SQL queries.

title: RuoYi 若依管理系统 默认弱密码漏洞
description: RuoYi ships with default administrative credentials admin/admin123. These credentials are widely known and trivially exploited. Systems deployed without credential rotation are immediately compromised.

title: Apache Shiro 路径穿越认证绕过漏洞
description: Apache Shiro before 1.5.3 allows path traversal in URL-based permission mapping. An attacker can bypass authentication by appending /../ sequences to resource URLs to access protected endpoints.

title: Campus SSO JWT 弱密钥伪造令牌攻击
description: Educational portal SSO systems using weak JWT signing keys (e.g. '123456', 'secret') can be forged by attackers to assume any identity including administrative roles.

title: Spring Boot Actuator 未授权端点敏感信息泄露
description: Spring Boot Actuator endpoints (/actuator/env, /actuator/heapdump, /actuator/mappings) expose sensitive runtime configuration, database credentials, and memory dumps when not properly secured.
